assumptions: Aggregates are identified by region == 'Aggregates' in the World Bank country list and excluded from all analysis.
No interpolation: a missing country-year stays null. Rankings and statistics use only countries with data.
Convergence is absolute (unconditional); correlations are descriptive; clusters are unsupervised labels. None is causal.
Income groups are the current World Bank classification at retrieval.
hhi5 is a 5-group export concentration index (DERIVED) that understates product-level concentration.
disclaimers: Educational use only. Not investment, policy or economic advice.
A dated snapshot of WDI, not a live feed; WDI revises history.
Latest-year values can be provisional estimates.

excluded_sources.name: IMF World Economic Outlook
excluded_sources.reason: Automated bulk download requires written permission (copyright@imf.org); no IMF endpoint is called.

latest_year_rule.text: Latest year per indicator = the latest year (from 2010) with a country count of at least 90 percent of that indicator's peak yearly count over 2010 to 2022. Missing values are never interpolated; rankings and statistics use only countries with data and publish n.
